notes.title: Eggy Launch Livestream Party
notes.content: To celebrate the release of Eggy, I wil host a livestream event at 7:00AM CEST. During the stream I will do a little AMA and talk about other development stuff regarding Eggy.

notes.title: Announcing the release date + pricing
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Steam Next Fest is about to begin, I hope you will have fun playing the Eggy demo! As promised I will reveal the launch date and pricing. Drum rolls please......

The game will launch on July 21st 2021 and will cost 11 dollars (pricing will vary depending on your country)

On launch day there will be a 20% discount, wishlist the game so you will get notified when Eggy releases.

Have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.content:
Starting on June 16th, during the Steam Next Fest, an Eggy demo will be available for you all to play. During this event I will also announce the release date.

Development-wise the game is pretty much done. Currently most of my work is marketing stuff and making sure people will know the game exists when it comes out. 

Also a big thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game. You are awesome! :)
